crucialFeats: Bound the Butcher inside his power battery
Kept fighting after his heart was removed
Used blood magic to read the future and track rage paths
Burned through the fabric of space with rage plasma
Overpowered Saint Walker, Indigo-1, and Star Sapphire together

dossier.advantage: Red ring instead of a heart and inhuman strength. The ring keeps him alive even after fatal wounds, and his physical power allows him to crush energy barriers and the armor of deities with his bare hands.
dossier.mentality: A furious zealot driven by revenge. He knows no mercy or hesitation – he pushes forward with a fury that grows more powerful the more hatred and anger the enemy shows him.
dossier.quote: I am Atrocitus, lord and master of the Red Lantern Corps. I am the one who will destroy the Guardians and all they stand for. I am wrath, I am hate, I am righteous vengeance!
dossier.style: Brutal, primal aggression. Atrocitus charges opponents to physically tear them apart with his bare hands, supported by corrosive rage plasma that burns through matter and space itself.

fighterA.name: Character A

powers: Red Lantern plasma output, constructs, blood magic and rituals, flight, and Butcher-linked rage dynamics.
tools: Emotional-spectrum manipulation and high-pressure ranged offense.
weaknesses: Ring or construct-output dependence and front-loaded control windows.
Prolonged direct brawls can reduce his tactical edge.

victories: Saint Walker, Indigo-1, and Star Sapphire (group overpowering)

crucialFeats: Planet and moon collateral output from World Breaker scale
Redirected Juggernaut's charge through tactical strength

dossier.advantage: Limitless strength scaling and regeneration. The more injured and angry he gets, the stronger he becomes, making him practically unbeatable in a war of attrition.
dossier.mentality: A stubborn and wild destroyer. He does not calculate or retreat – he pushes forward until all resistance is leveled to the ground.
dossier.style: Unstoppable close-quarters destruction. Relies on pure physical strength and constant forward momentum, crushing everything under his strikes.

fighterB.name: Character B

powers: Gamma-based strength growth, regeneration, thunderclap/shockwave output, and extreme stamina.
weaknesses: Limited precision utility at long range versus dedicated control users.
Strategy set is narrower when denied sustained contact.

fight-simulation.opening: Atrocitus opens with flight, plasma, and blood-rage control to keep Hulk from building a simple rhythm.
fight-simulation.mid_fight: Hulk absorbs the first control layer and keeps trying to collapse distance until the fight becomes physical anyway.
fight-simulation.late_fight: If Atrocitus keeps the fight external, he can stay ahead. If Hulk gets a second real contact sequence, regeneration and gamma escalation start erasing the value of every partial success.
fight-simulation.end_condition: Atrocitus has to hold range and control from start to finish; a second true contact sequence usually hands the fight to Hulk.
fight-simulation.phase_1_event: Atrocitus opens with flight, plasma, and blood-rage control to keep Hulk from building a simple rhythm.
fight-simulation.phase_2_event: Hulk absorbs the first control layer and keeps trying to collapse distance until the fight becomes physical anyway.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_a: Atrocitus keeps the fight outside and continues managing Hulk's rage from range.
fight-simulation.phase_2_branch_b: Hulk forces another contact sequence and starts turning Atrocitus' partial wins into fuel for the next exchange.
fight-simulation.phase_3_event: If Atrocitus keeps the fight external, he can stay ahead. If Hulk gets a second real contact sequence, regeneration and gamma escalation start erasing the value of every partial success.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_a: Distance and control hold from start to finish, so Atrocitus stays ahead of the escalation curve.
fight-simulation.phase_3_branch_b: A second real contact sequence triggers the gamma loop and starts erasing the value of Atrocitus' earlier success.

final-summary.line_1: Atrocitus wins the paper comparison, 85.6 vs 83.9.
final-summary.line_2: Hulk wins more real fights because repeat contact and regeneration create the cleaner finish route.
final-summary.line_3: Atrocitus only flips the matchup if distance and control hold from start to finish.

stat-trap.question: Can Atrocitus keep Hulk's rage external, or does he end up feeding the loop himself?
stat-trap.trap_bottom: DO NOT GUARANTEE A FINISH ROUTE
stat-trap.example: Better averages do not matter if they do not create a finish route. Atrocitus has more ways to shape the opening, but Hulk gets more dangerous every time the fight resets into contact. This is not about who has more tools. It is about whose win condition stays intact after the first plan fails.

tactical-board.lane: Atrocitus wins by keeping the fight structured. Hulk wins by turning structure into a repeat contact loop.
tactical-board.subtitle: Butcher versus Worldbreaker

x-factor.mechanics: If Atrocitus keeps Hulk at range and manages the fight from the outside, his plasma, rituals, and flight can stay ahead of the escalation curve.
x-factor.implication: The winner is decided by whether rage remains externally managed or becomes self-sustaining gamma escalation.
x-factor.psychology: If Hulk forces repeat contact, rage control stops being a leash and starts becoming fuel for a stronger future exchange.

interpretation.line_1: Atrocitus owns the cleaner early toolkit, better speed, and stronger control options.
interpretation.line_2: Hulk owns the cleaner finish route once contact becomes repeatable.
interpretation.line_3: This is a matchup where the paper edge belongs to the more versatile side, but the practical edge belongs to the side whose loop gets stronger every time the control plan slips.
interpretation.quote: Atrocitus wins the paper comparison, but Hulk still wins more real fights.

battle-dynamics.phase_1: Atrocitus shapes the opening through faster control and the cleaner toolkit.
battle-dynamics.phase_2: Hulk rises once the fight resets into contact and partial damage stops slowing him down.
battle-dynamics.phase_3: The longer contact lasts, the more dangerous Hulk's loop becomes.
battle-dynamics.analysis: Atrocitus is stronger early, but Hulk rises fast once regeneration and repeat entries stop caring about partial damage.
